title: Figure 6: SiC-based super-lens imaging sub-wavelength holes buried under SiO2 layer
description: Panel (a) is a 3D cross-section schematic of a layered stack (SiO2 200 nm, SiC 400 nm, SiO2 200 nm, Au 50 nm) with a near-field microscope tip and red arrows indicating laser illumination and scattering. Panels d-g are false-color near-field scan images in which four buried holes appear as dark or bright spots depending on wavelength. Caption: "Figure 6. Schematic of the SiC-Based Super-Lens Which is Imaging Sub-Wavelength Holes Buried Under the SiO2 Layer."
